run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the largest subarray with equal 0s and 1s in a binary array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets to validate correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash map approach for O(n) time complexity instead of O(n^2)
review_f_gold: review f_gold which treats 0s as -1 and 1s as +1 to find zero-sum subarrays
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that returns the max subarray size with equal counts of 0s and 1s
